'''sniper222 Just an old school style.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published (no section counts given).
* There Is No Try dested the printed Dagobah Effect (author plays no shields); Ability, Ability, Ability the printed Cloud City card.
* Posted 'Captain Peitt' dested Captain Piett; 'Bosk In Hound's Tooth' Bossk In Hound's Tooth.

== Strategy ==

This is a death star deck with little guys in white suits running around, dying, and poping up again. Stormtroopers are my retreaving force people. Instead of relying on bountys(Which usuly fail for me) I'll loose stormtroopers in battle and force drains and then retrieve them back. The death star will knock out unwanted planets and my Space deck is pritty stable. I also am playing peaple you don't play with card past special addition, so I can't use v cards

or shields. I was wondering what a shield is. I have heard about it, but don't qtite understand, so if anybody can explain it to me that would be appreciated.
